'''Shōko Tsuda''' (Japanese: '''津田匠子''' ''Tsuda Shōko'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Tsuda was born on January 30, 1963 in {{wp|Nagasaki Prefecture, Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. Tsuda joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|RS}}, voicing several characters, most notably [[Shelly]] from [[Team Aqua]]. Years later, Tsuda returned in {{aniseries|JN}}, voicing [[Professor Magnolia]].
